question: Milk and face cream are examples of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**emulsion.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The emulsion** is a mixture of two immiscible liquids, where one liquid is dispersed in the other in the form of small droplets**.
 
• **Milk and face cream are examples of emulsions because they are made by mixing oil and water together with the help of an emulsifying agent.**
 
• Emulsions can be either oil-in-water (o/w) or water-in-oil (w/o) emulsions, depending on which liquid is dispersed in the other.
 
• Emulsifying agents are substances that help stabilize emulsions by reducing the surface tension between the two liquids.​__
